notes.title: 25.09.25 Update Patch
notes.content: [h1]25.09.25 Patch[/h1][h2]Performance[/h2][list][*][p][b]\[Important][/b] Optimized online networking. Multiplayer should now be more stable with lower latency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Important][/b] When FPS drops, graphics quality will automatically switch to [b]Low[/b] (you can disable this in [b]Settings[/b]).[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]\[Important][/b] Fixed an issue where mushrooms in the [b]Magic Forest[/b] couldn’t be pulled up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Important] [/b]Fixed the [b]“[/b]Ancient Knowledge[b]”[/b] achievement so it now triggers correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the trailer could no longer steer after being loaded with many items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous animal pathfinding issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fireworks being visible only to the host—now everyone can see them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being unable to pull up beets at low frame rates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a “Burger King” minigame bug that caused all players to be unable to perform any actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stumps not awarding a blueprint when removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the [b]“[/b]Ancient Knowledge[b]”[/b] achievement so it now triggers correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various client-side presentation issues in Transformation Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clients in multiplayer sometimes being unable to equip clothing, and resolved outfit sync issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the stone mill not being tetherable with a rope.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]\[Important][/b] You can now have your dog [b]pull the basket[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added minimap icons for the Portable Seed Bag and the Green Caterpillar Gacha Machine.[/p][/*][/list][h2]English Version[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed several text errors and missing translations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 25.09.24 Update Patch
notes.content: [p][b]We’re sorry![/b][/p][p]Today’s save loading update may cause the save file order to display incorrectly. Please manually locate your most recent save file by checking the timestamp when loading. We will work quickly to fix this issue.[/p][p][/p][p][b]25.09.24 Update Patch[/b][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Attempted to fix trailer jitter issues; trailers should now be less likely to break apart at low framerates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a save error in the Burger King mini-game where completed challenge counts would reset upon re-entering the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect track descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where swordfish did not jump when landing on shore.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blueprint inconsistencies after demolishing certain buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could not obtain the crown after exchanging all trophies for track trophies; track trophies can now also be used to unlock crowns.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed achievements for catching geese and catching mice not being completable.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The camera can now be stored in the backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]Using an outfit ball identical to the one currently equipped will now unequip the outfit.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Performance Optimization:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Performed a round of optimizations; framerate should be improved on low-performance devices.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]English Version:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some text errors and untranslated text.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 25.09.23 Update Patch
notes.content: [p][b]25.09.23 Update Patch[/b][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p]-Adjusted the basket-carrying feature. Baskets should now be less likely to get stuck together or in fences, but they are also easier to break.[/p][p]-Fixed an issue where players couldn’t exit certain vehicles.[/p][p]-Fixed other miscellaneous bugs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Feature:[/b][/p][p]-Baskets can now be packed just like vehicles. If a basket gets stuck, you can pack it and then release it safely elsewhere.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Controller Support:[/b][/p][p]-Added controller input support. You can now play [i]Island Time[/i] with a gamepad.[/p]
